value.rationale: The nearest Fourier zero of a natural, uniform, geometrically distinguished atomic support is a scale-invariant observable motivated by the current geometric Fourier-zero literature. This result gives the exact zero-free radius and all extremizing frequencies for every odd dimensional demicube, not a one-off small numerical instance. The codimension of the entire real zero set changes from exactly d−2 to a generic d−1 hypersurface between odd and even dimensions. These are structural geometric invariants of a canonical family, beyond merely plugging parameters into a known inequality; no general-purpose downstream theorem is claimed.
